title: About the Commonwealth
text: About the Commonwealth Welcome to the Commonwealth of Greenwick — an independent micronation founded on the principles of democracy, unity, and civic responsibility. Situated off the coast of Belize, Greenwick is home to a vibrant and growing community of over 14,000 citizens who proudly participate in building a future based on fairness, justice, and opportunity for all. Our Foundation The Commonwealth of Greenwick was officially established in 2023 under the leadership of His Majesty King Ashton I , marking the beginning of a new chapter in self-governance and civic innovation. Built on a constitutional framework that blends parliamentary democracy with a ceremonial monarchy, Greenwick upholds the values of freedom, integrity, and social progress. title: Royal Archives
text: Royal Archives Royal Archives The Royal Archives of the Commonwealth of Greenwick safeguard the official historical record of the nation, including its transformation, leadership, and royal legacy. These archives are maintained to preserve national identity, inform future generations, and honor the history of the monarchy and government. Historical Background The territory was originally founded in 2023 under the name Veridonia —a community-led region with a vision of independence, sustainability, and unity. At this time, it operated with informal governance and no royal structure. In 2024 , the nation was formally restructured and renamed to the Commonwealth of Greenwick . This transition marked the beginning of a constitutional monarchy , a codified government, and an emphasis on democratic values and citizen representation.
